For developers

Ship voice in five lines of code

SDKs for Python and TypeScript, WebSocket streaming, and webhooks for long jobs.

  • Streaming over HTTP and WebSocket
  • SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and zero-retention mode
  • Pay per character, no minimum commitment
# pip install sonara
from sonara import Sonara

client = Sonara(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY")

audio = client.text_to_speech.convert(
    voice_id="aria",
    model_id="sonara_v3",
    text="[excited] We just hit our launch goal!",
)

with open("launch.mp3", "wb") as f:
    f.write(audio)
